meta.title: Gazing Upon Distant Stars
meta.description: As you gaze upon distant stars, you find that although the road is arduous, you have never been alone.

units.rawText: ...If it weren't for you, we would've never broken out of the Sanctifiers' encirclement.
units.displayText: ...If it weren't for you, we would've never broken out of the Sanctifiers' encirclement.

spans.text: ...If it weren't for you, we would've never broken out of the Sanctifiers' encirclement.

units.rawText: Professor, thank you for your assistance.
units.displayText: Professor, thank you for your assistance.

spans.text: Professor, thank you for your assistance.

units.rawText: I was just following my gut. I most certainly never expected to meet you back there, Persicaria.
units.displayText: I was just following my gut. I most certainly never expected to meet you back there, Persicaria.

spans.text: I was just following my gut. I most certainly never expected to meet you back there, Persicaria.

units.rawText: ...Plus, it wasn't just me who helped you drive away the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: ...Plus, it wasn't just me who helped you drive away the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: ...Plus, it wasn't just me who helped you drive away the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Eh? What do you mean?
units.displayText: Eh? What do you mean?

spans.text: Eh? What do you mean?

units.rawText: I turn to look at Sangoma beside me.
units.displayText: I turn to look at Sangoma beside me.

spans.text: I turn to look at Sangoma beside me.

units.rawText: Sangoma notices my attention shift toward her. She gently shakes her head and raises a finger to her lips in a "shhh" gesture.
units.displayText: Sangoma notices my attention shift toward her. She gently shakes her head and raises a finger to her lips in a "shhh" gesture.

spans.text: Sangoma notices my attention shift toward her. She gently shakes her head and raises a finger to her lips in a "shhh" gesture.

units.rawText: ...Never mind. Persicaria, let's get back to fixing the memory fragment.
units.displayText: ...Never mind. Persicaria, let's get back to fixing the memory fragment.

spans.text: ...Never mind. Persicaria, let's get back to fixing the memory fragment.

units.rawText: If my memory serves me correctly, we should have met at the rendezvous point shortly after you left the danger zone...
units.displayText: If my memory serves me correctly, we should have met at the rendezvous point shortly after you left the danger zone...

spans.text: If my memory serves me correctly, we should have met at the rendezvous point shortly after you left the danger zone...

units.rawText: As I'm approaching the coordinates Sangoma told me, I begin to see the pink and orange-haired Dolls emerge from the horizon.
units.displayText: As I'm approaching the coordinates Sangoma told me, I begin to see the pink and orange-haired Dolls emerge from the horizon.

spans.text: As I'm approaching the coordinates Sangoma told me, I begin to see the pink and orange-haired Dolls emerge from the horizon.

units.rawText: (So the coordinates Sangoma told me is the rendezvous point to meet those two Dolls... I wonder how she's doing on her end.)
units.displayText: So the coordinates Sangoma told me is the rendezvous point to meet those two Dolls... I wonder how she's doing on her end.

spans.text: So the coordinates Sangoma told me is the rendezvous point to meet those two Dolls... I wonder how she's doing on her end.

units.rawText: (Speaking of which, is she really capable of handling that many Sanctifiers by herself...?)
units.displayText: Speaking of which, is she really capable of handling that many Sanctifiers by herself...?

spans.text: Speaking of which, is she really capable of handling that many Sanctifiers by herself...?

units.rawText: The amulet Sangoma gave me vibrates briefly. I open the amulet, and I find a communicator hidden inside. Its dim screen displays a message from her.
units.displayText: The amulet Sangoma gave me vibrates briefly. I open the amulet, and I find a communicator hidden inside. Its dim screen displays a message from her.

spans.text: The amulet Sangoma gave me vibrates briefly. I open the amulet, and I find a communicator hidden inside. Its dim screen displays a message from her.

units.rawText: "All clear. Don't worry."
units.displayText: "All clear. Don't worry."

spans.text: "All clear. Don't worry."

units.rawText: (So that's the "special benefit" she talked about.)
units.displayText: So that's the "special benefit" she talked about.

spans.text: So that's the "special benefit" she talked about.

units.rawText: "This uses a private channel just for <cmdr> and I. Nobody will ever find out about this. Remember to keep it close."
units.displayText: "This uses a private channel just for {교수} and I. Nobody will ever find out about this. Remember to keep it close."

spans.text: "This uses a private channel just for
and I. Nobody will ever find out about this. Remember to keep it close."

units.rawText: (...I haven't even sent anything. Is she also a mind-reader?)
units.displayText: ...I haven't even sent anything. Is she also a mind-reader?

spans.text: ...I haven't even sent anything. Is she also a mind-reader?

units.rawText: "Yes, I'm a psychic."
units.displayText: "Yes, I'm a psychic."

spans.text: "Yes, I'm a psychic."

units.rawText: I'm so glad to have met you again.
units.displayText: I'm so glad to have met you again.

spans.text: I'm so glad to have met you again.

units.rawText: Me too. I'm relieved to see you in one piece.
units.displayText: Me too. I'm relieved to see you in one piece.

spans.text: Me too. I'm relieved to see you in one piece.

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll walks toward me. As I'm about to put the communication module back into the amulet, another message pops up.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll walks toward me. As I'm about to put the communication module back into the amulet, another message pops up.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll walks toward me. As I'm about to put the communication module back into the amulet, another message pops up.

units.rawText: "Don't tell anyone anything about me."
units.displayText: "Don't tell anyone anything about me."

spans.text: "Don't tell anyone anything about me."

units.rawText: I'd like to express my gratitude for your aid back there. You saved us.
units.displayText: I'd like to express my gratitude for your aid back there. You saved us.

spans.text: I'd like to express my gratitude for your aid back there. You saved us.

units.rawText: No problem. I merely did what needed to be done.
units.displayText: No problem. I merely did what needed to be done.

spans.text: No problem. I merely did what needed to be done.

units.rawText: There's one thing I'd like to confirm with you... Are you the Professor?
units.displayText: There's one thing I'd like to confirm with you... Are you the Professor?

spans.text: There's one thing I'd like to confirm with you... Are you the Professor?

units.rawText: (Cough) Yes, I am the director of Project Neural Cloud.
units.displayText: (Cough) Yes, I am the director of Project Neural Cloud.

spans.text: (Cough) Yes, I am the director of Project Neural Cloud.

units.rawText: Though I've mentally prepared for it, this new title still doesn't sit quite right with me.
units.displayText: Though I've mentally prepared for it, this new title still doesn't sit quite right with me.

spans.text: Though I've mentally prepared for it, this new title still doesn't sit quite right with me.

units.rawText: Might there be any issues? Per... Persicaria?
units.displayText: Might there be any issues? Per... Persicaria?

spans.text: Might there be any issues? Per... Persicaria?

units.rawText: I stutter, as I'm not sure what to do. Her looks resemble the Persica I know in my memories, but her presence feels strangely different, in a way that I can't quite put into words.
units.displayText: I stutter, as I'm not sure what to do. Her looks resemble the Persica I know in my memories, but her presence feels strangely different, in a way that I can't quite put into words.

spans.text: I stutter, as I'm not sure what to do. Her looks resemble the Persica I know in my memories, but her presence feels strangely different, in a way that I can't quite put into words.

units.rawText: I don't understand this noted difference yet. I give her the simplest answer possible to avoid raising suspicion about my true identity.
units.displayText: I don't understand this noted difference yet. I give her the simplest answer possible to avoid raising suspicion about my true identity.

spans.text: I don't understand this noted difference yet. I give her the simplest answer possible to avoid raising suspicion about my true identity.

units.rawText: ...I know I'm being rude, but I still have a few things I'd like to confirm with you...
units.displayText: ...I know I'm being rude, but I still have a few things I'd like to confirm with you...

spans.text: ...I know I'm being rude, but I still have a few things I'd like to confirm with you...

units.rawText: Professor?! THE Professor, for real?
units.displayText: Professor?! THE Professor, for real?

spans.text: Professor?! THE Professor, for real?

units.rawText: Persicaria is about to say something, but the orange-haired Doll is unable to hold her excitement and dashes in front of me.
units.displayText: Persicaria is about to say something, but the orange-haired Doll is unable to hold her excitement and dashes in front of me.

spans.text: Persicaria is about to say something, but the orange-haired Doll is unable to hold her excitement and dashes in front of me.

units.rawText: Uh, yeah...
units.displayText: Uh, yeah...

spans.text: Uh, yeah...

units.rawText: From their signature, they're indeed the Professor I know. But...
units.displayText: From their signature, they're indeed the Professor I know. But...

spans.text: From their signature, they're indeed the Professor I know. But...

units.rawText: Noticing the orange-haired Doll's excitement, Persicaria holds back the second half of her sentence.
units.displayText: Noticing the orange-haired Doll's excitement, Persicaria holds back the second half of her sentence.

spans.text: Noticing the orange-haired Doll's excitement, Persicaria holds back the second half of her sentence.

units.rawText: <size=40>The Professor has come to the Cloud to rescue us! We've made it, Persicaria!</size>
units.displayText: The Professor has come to the Cloud to rescue us! We've made it, Persicaria!

spans.text: The Professor has come to the Cloud to rescue us! We've made it, Persicaria!

units.rawText: We're so lucky we went out gathering resources today! The Professor has to be our greatest find yet!
units.displayText: We're so lucky we went out gathering resources today! The Professor has to be our greatest find yet!

spans.text: We're so lucky we went out gathering resources today! The Professor has to be our greatest find yet!

units.rawText: I most likely can't be categorized as "resources", but sure... Speaking of which, may I have your name?
units.displayText: I most likely can't be categorized as "resources", but sure... Speaking of which, may I have your name?

spans.text: I most likely can't be categorized as "resources", but sure... Speaking of which, may I have your name?

units.rawText: Oh, right. I haven't introduced myself.
units.displayText: Oh, right. I haven't introduced myself.

spans.text: Oh, right. I haven't introduced myself.

units.rawText: I'm Persicaria's friend. You can call me <color=orange>Sol</color>, Professor!
units.displayText: I'm Persicaria's friend. You can call me Sol, Professor!

spans.text: I'm Persicaria's friend. You can call me
Sol
, Professor!

units.rawText: Sol, right? Nice to meet you.
units.displayText: Sol, right? Nice to meet you.

spans.text: Sol, right? Nice to meet you.

units.rawText: Yeah! Nice to meet you, Professor!
units.displayText: Yeah! Nice to meet you, Professor!

spans.text: Yeah! Nice to meet you, Professor!

units.rawText: With the Professor's help, I'm sure there'll be less of a burden on Persicaria's shoulders!
units.displayText: With the Professor's help, I'm sure there'll be less of a burden on Persicaria's shoulders!

spans.text: With the Professor's help, I'm sure there'll be less of a burden on Persicaria's shoulders!

units.rawText: ...Ah, yes.
units.displayText: ...Ah, yes.

spans.text: ...Ah, yes.

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll turns around, mapping out the next route while keeping a watchful eye on the surroundings.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll turns around, mapping out the next route while keeping a watchful eye on the surroundings.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll turns around, mapping out the next route while keeping a watchful eye on the surroundings.

units.rawText: Right, Professor, are you here to bring us back to reality?
units.displayText: Right, Professor, are you here to bring us back to reality?

spans.text: Right, Professor, are you here to bring us back to reality?

units.rawText: Sol's innocent question cuts straight to the heart of the problem.
units.displayText: Sol's innocent question cuts straight to the heart of the problem.

spans.text: Sol's innocent question cuts straight to the heart of the problem.

units.rawText: I sneak a glance at Persicaria beside me. Though her back is turned, her ears twitch and perk up as she catches our conversation.
units.displayText: I sneak a glance at Persicaria beside me. Though her back is turned, her ears twitch and perk up as she catches our conversation.

spans.text: I sneak a glance at Persicaria beside me. Though her back is turned, her ears twitch and perk up as she catches our conversation.

units.rawText: ...Uhm, yes.
units.displayText: ...Uhm, yes.

spans.text: ...Uhm, yes.

units.rawText: Then we must tell everyone else about it! That's a huge deal, you know.
units.displayText: Then we must tell everyone else about it! That's a huge deal, you know.

spans.text: Then we must tell everyone else about it! That's a huge deal, you know.

units.rawText: About that... I need to explain something first.
units.displayText: About that... I need to explain something first.

spans.text: About that... I need to explain something first.

units.rawText: I recount my findings in the Neural Cloud Sector to the two, carefully removing Sangoma from the story.
units.displayText: I recount my findings in the Neural Cloud Sector to the two, carefully removing Sangoma from the story.

spans.text: I recount my findings in the Neural Cloud Sector to the two, carefully removing Sangoma from the story.

units.rawText: ...So that's the situation. Sorry, I can't use the uploader to bring you back to reality.
units.displayText: ...So that's the situation. Sorry, I can't use the uploader to bring you back to reality.

spans.text: ...So that's the situation. Sorry, I can't use the uploader to bring you back to reality.

units.rawText: Oh well... That's a bummer.
units.displayText: Oh well... That's a bummer.

spans.text: Oh well... That's a bummer.

units.rawText: Still, don't let it bother you! We'll figure out another way!
units.displayText: Still, don't let it bother you! We'll figure out another way!

spans.text: Still, don't let it bother you! We'll figure out another way!

units.rawText: ...I don't understand.
units.displayText: ...I don't understand.

spans.text: ...I don't understand.

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll gently shakes her head, her gaze filling with confusion.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll gently shakes her head, her gaze filling with confusion.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll gently shakes her head, her gaze filling with confusion.

units.rawText: Why did you come here, knowing there was a chance you might never return to reality?
units.displayText: Why did you come here, knowing there was a chance you might never return to reality?

spans.text: Why did you come here, knowing there was a chance you might never return to reality?

units.rawText: The risks of uploading one's mind to search for some Dolls far outweigh the benefits.
units.displayText: The risks of uploading one's mind to search for some Dolls far outweigh the benefits.

spans.text: The risks of uploading one's mind to search for some Dolls far outweigh the benefits.

units.rawText: This place is far more dangerous than you could've ever imagined.. One wrong step could mean... could mean...
units.displayText: This place is far more dangerous than you could've ever imagined.. One wrong step could mean... could mean...

spans.text: This place is far more dangerous than you could've ever imagined.. One wrong step could mean... could mean...

units.rawText: She seems to reflect on something, a trace of sadness crossing her face.
units.displayText: She seems to reflect on something, a trace of sadness crossing her face.

spans.text: She seems to reflect on something, a trace of sadness crossing her face.

units.rawText: The answer to that question isn't as complicated as you think, Persicaria.
units.displayText: The answer to that question isn't as complicated as you think, Persicaria.

spans.text: The answer to that question isn't as complicated as you think, Persicaria.

units.rawText: I give the shivering girl in front of me a warm smile.
units.displayText: I give the shivering girl in front of me a warm smile.

spans.text: I give the shivering girl in front of me a warm smile.

units.rawText: I just wanted to help you. That's all the reason I'd ever need.
units.displayText: I just wanted to help you. That's all the reason I'd ever need.

spans.text: I just wanted to help you. That's all the reason I'd ever need.

units.rawText: Persicaria's weary eyes briefly glimmer with hope, but that light quickly fades again.
units.displayText: Persicaria's weary eyes briefly glimmer with hope, but that light quickly fades again.

spans.text: Persicaria's weary eyes briefly glimmer with hope, but that light quickly fades again.

units.rawText: Those are fine words. Nonetheless, welcome to Magrasea... Professor.
units.displayText: Those are fine words. Nonetheless, welcome to Magrasea... Professor.

spans.text: Those are fine words. Nonetheless, welcome to Magrasea... Professor.

units.rawText: Yes.
units.displayText: Yes.

spans.text: Yes.

units.rawText: I don't quite get what on earth you two are talking about...
units.displayText: I don't quite get what on earth you two are talking about...

spans.text: I don't quite get what on earth you two are talking about...

units.rawText: Whatever, let's head on back to our makeshift encampment with our Professor!
units.displayText: Whatever, let's head on back to our makeshift encampment with our Professor!

spans.text: Whatever, let's head on back to our makeshift encampment with our Professor!

units.rawText: Makeshift encampment?
units.displayText: Makeshift encampment?

spans.text: Makeshift encampment?

units.rawText: Persicaria found that place! Thanks to her, everyone's got a safe shelter to rest in!
units.displayText: Persicaria found that place! Thanks to her, everyone's got a safe shelter to rest in!

spans.text: Persicaria found that place! Thanks to her, everyone's got a safe shelter to rest in!

units.rawText: It's really just a small section of the ruins that's less exposed, a place that's not entirely safe by any means.
units.displayText: It's really just a small section of the ruins that's less exposed, a place that's not entirely safe by any means.

spans.text: It's really just a small section of the ruins that's less exposed, a place that's not entirely safe by any means.

units.rawText: Heh, really? It's much better than the previous ones, I'd say.
units.displayText: Heh, really? It's much better than the previous ones, I'd say.

spans.text: Heh, really? It's much better than the previous ones, I'd say.

units.rawText: Sol scratches her head as she continues introducing the place in excitement.
units.displayText: Sol scratches her head as she continues introducing the place in excitement.

spans.text: Sol scratches her head as she continues introducing the place in excitement.

units.rawText: Other than the two of us, some other Dolls who joined Project Neural Cloud are also staying at the camp. They'll be thrilled to hear about your arrival to the Cloud, Professor!
units.displayText: Other than the two of us, some other Dolls who joined Project Neural Cloud are also staying at the camp. They'll be thrilled to hear about your arrival to the Cloud, Professor!

spans.text: Other than the two of us, some other Dolls who joined Project Neural Cloud are also staying at the camp. They'll be thrilled to hear about your arrival to the Cloud, Professor!

units.rawText: I'm sure you're thinking the same thing, aren't you, Persicaria?
units.displayText: I'm sure you're thinking the same thing, aren't you, Persicaria?

spans.text: I'm sure you're thinking the same thing, aren't you, Persicaria?

units.rawText: Professor, would you like to go to the camp with us?
units.displayText: Professor, would you like to go to the camp with us?

spans.text: Professor, would you like to go to the camp with us?

units.rawText: Going with Persicaria will definitely grant me more information, but what about Sangoma...
units.displayText: Going with Persicaria will definitely grant me more information, but what about Sangoma...

spans.text: Going with Persicaria will definitely grant me more information, but what about Sangoma...

units.rawText: As I grapple with the dilemma before me, Sangoma silently emerges from a blind spot, unseen by Persicaria and Sol. She gives me an OK sign before vanishing just as quickly.
units.displayText: As I grapple with the dilemma before me, Sangoma silently emerges from a blind spot, unseen by Persicaria and Sol. She gives me an OK sign before vanishing just as quickly.

spans.text: As I grapple with the dilemma before me, Sangoma silently emerges from a blind spot, unseen by Persicaria and Sol. She gives me an OK sign before vanishing just as quickly.

units.rawText: Professor?
units.displayText: Professor?

spans.text: Professor?

units.rawText: Hm? Do you smell that weird fragrance, or am I imagining things?
units.displayText: Hm? Do you smell that weird fragrance, or am I imagining things?

spans.text: Hm? Do you smell that weird fragrance, or am I imagining things?

units.rawText: The two beside me remain unaware of Sangoma, their focus fully on getting me back to the encampment.
units.displayText: The two beside me remain unaware of Sangoma, their focus fully on getting me back to the encampment.

spans.text: The two beside me remain unaware of Sangoma, their focus fully on getting me back to the encampment.

units.rawText: ...Perhaps the fragrance is from my scent sachet.
units.displayText: ...Perhaps the fragrance is from my scent sachet.

spans.text: ...Perhaps the fragrance is from my scent sachet.

units.rawText: Take me to your secret base. Let's go.
units.displayText: Take me to your secret base. Let's go.

spans.text: Take me to your secret base. Let's go.

units.rawText: You guys have been through a lot as well, I see...
units.displayText: You guys have been through a lot as well, I see...

spans.text: You guys have been through a lot as well, I see...

units.rawText: Yeah, we wouldn't have made it without Persicaria's leadership.
units.displayText: Yeah, we wouldn't have made it without Persicaria's leadership.

spans.text: Yeah, we wouldn't have made it without Persicaria's leadership.

units.rawText: Our camp is pretty safe now, but we haven't found enough operands and resources to supply ourselves.
units.displayText: Our camp is pretty safe now, but we haven't found enough operands and resources to supply ourselves.

spans.text: Our camp is pretty safe now, but we haven't found enough operands and resources to supply ourselves.

units.rawText: That's why Persicaria and I risked venturing out for resources, and it was that very day we ran into the Sanctifiers... Then, you arrived and saved the day, Professor!
units.displayText: That's why Persicaria and I risked venturing out for resources, and it was that very day we ran into the Sanctifiers... Then, you arrived and saved the day, Professor!

spans.text: That's why Persicaria and I risked venturing out for resources, and it was that very day we ran into the Sanctifiers... Then, you arrived and saved the day, Professor!

units.rawText: So that's how it went...
units.displayText: So that's how it went...

spans.text: So that's how it went...

units.rawText: I sneak a glance at Persicaria behind us. She's been keeping a sharp eye on the surroundings since Sol and I started the conversation.
units.displayText: I sneak a glance at Persicaria behind us. She's been keeping a sharp eye on the surroundings since Sol and I started the conversation.

spans.text: I sneak a glance at Persicaria behind us. She's been keeping a sharp eye on the surroundings since Sol and I started the conversation.

units.rawText: Having depleted her operands earlier, she's clearly overwhelmed by fatigue, and I can't help but notice her unsteady gait.
units.displayText: Having depleted her operands earlier, she's clearly overwhelmed by fatigue, and I can't help but notice her unsteady gait.

spans.text: Having depleted her operands earlier, she's clearly overwhelmed by fatigue, and I can't help but notice her unsteady gait.

units.rawText: Noticing her condition, I slow down and walk beside her, quietly moving some of the resources she's carrying on her back onto mine.
units.displayText: Noticing her condition, I slow down and walk beside her, quietly moving some of the resources she's carrying on her back onto mine.

spans.text: Noticing her condition, I slow down and walk beside her, quietly moving some of the resources she's carrying on her back onto mine.

units.rawText: ...Professor, you're not supposed to be carrying those.
units.displayText: ...Professor, you're not supposed to be carrying those.

spans.text: ...Professor, you're not supposed to be carrying those.

units.rawText: You're already overburdened. There's no need for you to carry what I can.
units.displayText: You're already overburdened. There's no need for you to carry what I can.

spans.text: You're already overburdened. There's no need for you to carry what I can.

units.rawText: Now's not the time to act tough.
units.displayText: Now's not the time to act tough.

spans.text: Now's not the time to act tough.

units.rawText: Sol, and everyone else would be worried for you if you fell here.
units.displayText: Sol, and everyone else would be worried for you if you fell here.

spans.text: Sol, and everyone else would be worried for you if you fell here.

units.rawText: Persicaria hesitates for a moment before finally deciding not to argue further, silently following behind me.
units.displayText: Persicaria hesitates for a moment before finally deciding not to argue further, silently following behind me.

spans.text: Persicaria hesitates for a moment before finally deciding not to argue further, silently following behind me.

units.rawText: We've arrived, Professor! This is our makeshift encampment!
units.displayText: We've arrived, Professor! This is our makeshift encampment!

spans.text: We've arrived, Professor! This is our makeshift encampment!

units.rawText: I look at the direction Sol's pointing at.
units.displayText: I look at the direction Sol's pointing at.

spans.text: I look at the direction Sol's pointing at.

units.rawText: Even though I had lowered my expectations, the current situation is far worse than I ever could've anticipated.
units.displayText: Even though I had lowered my expectations, the current situation is far worse than I ever could've anticipated.

spans.text: Even though I had lowered my expectations, the current situation is far worse than I ever could've anticipated.

units.rawText: Well, there's no rooms, no bedrolls, just living spaces separated by duck cloth...
units.displayText: Well, there's no rooms, no bedrolls, just living spaces separated by duck cloth...

spans.text: Well, there's no rooms, no bedrolls, just living spaces separated by duck cloth...

units.rawText: But hey, it's better than nothing.
units.displayText: But hey, it's better than nothing.

spans.text: But hey, it's better than nothing.

units.rawText: Finding a safe spot in this place full of holes and gaps is pretty much a miracle. It's the only reason we've stayed undetected by the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Finding a safe spot in this place full of holes and gaps is pretty much a miracle. It's the only reason we've stayed undetected by the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Finding a safe spot in this place full of holes and gaps is pretty much a miracle. It's the only reason we've stayed undetected by the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: You're finally back... Wait, how did you two end up with all these wounds?
units.displayText: You're finally back... Wait, how did you two end up with all these wounds?

spans.text: You're finally back... Wait, how did you two end up with all these wounds?

units.rawText: Uh, we had a little trouble on our way to the resources. Look, I found the thing you wanted, Croque...
units.displayText: Uh, we had a little trouble on our way to the resources. Look, I found the thing you wanted, Croque...

spans.text: Uh, we had a little trouble on our way to the resources. Look, I found the thing you wanted, Croque...

units.rawText: ...We'll talk about the resources later.
units.displayText: ...We'll talk about the resources later.

spans.text: ...We'll talk about the resources later.

units.displayText: The gray-haired Doll pulls Sol to her side and whispers to her.

spans.text: The gray-haired Doll pulls Sol to her side and whispers to her.

units.rawText: Who's this strange person in the lab coat with you? I don't think I've ever seen them before...
units.displayText: Who's this strange person in the lab coat with you? I don't think I've ever seen them before...

spans.text: Who's this strange person in the lab coat with you? I don't think I've ever seen them before...

units.rawText: Well...

units.rawText: Ah? Oh! I see.
units.displayText: Ah? Oh! I see.

spans.text: Ah? Oh! I see.

units.rawText: Sol quickly catches on to my intent. She steps out of the tent and closes the flap, leaving me alone with Persicaria.
units.displayText: Sol quickly catches on to my intent. She steps out of the tent and closes the flap, leaving me alone with Persicaria.

units.rawText: ...Take this as though I'm just talking to myself.
units.displayText: ...Take this as though I'm just talking to myself.

spans.text: ...Take this as though I'm just talking to myself.

units.rawText: Persicaria, I know you still don't trust me entirely.
units.displayText: Persicaria, I know you still don't trust me entirely.

spans.text: Persicaria, I know you still don't trust me entirely.

units.rawText: I know you probably don't believe in my words, but even then, I still want to tell you.
units.displayText: I know you probably don't believe in my words, but even then, I still want to tell you.

spans.text: I know you probably don't believe in my words, but even then, I still want to tell you.

units.rawText: ...No one was to blame for Knot's death.
units.displayText: ...No one was to blame for Knot's death.

spans.text: ...No one was to blame for Knot's death.

units.rawText: It was the only choice left, for you and for her. That's all there was to it.
units.displayText: It was the only choice left, for you and for her. That's all there was to it.

spans.text: It was the only choice left, for you and for her. That's all there was to it.

units.rawText: Persicaria breathes in an even rhythm, not showing any signs of her waking up.
units.displayText: Persicaria breathes in an even rhythm, not showing any signs of her waking up.

spans.text: Persicaria breathes in an even rhythm, not showing any signs of her waking up.

units.rawText: While you were sleeping soundly, I spoke with everyone at the camp. They've all been worried about you and want you to get some proper rest.
units.displayText: While you were sleeping soundly, I spoke with everyone at the camp. They've all been worried about you and want you to get some proper rest.

spans.text: While you were sleeping soundly, I spoke with everyone at the camp. They've all been worried about you and want you to get some proper rest.

units.rawText: I assume you'll be bringing everyone to the Oasis next.
units.displayText: I assume you'll be bringing everyone to the Oasis next.

spans.text: I assume you'll be bringing everyone to the Oasis next.

units.rawText: I want to see the Oasis you painted in your dream for myself. I will help you... No, I'll be by your side as we fulfill your dream together.
units.displayText: I want to see the Oasis you painted in your dream for myself. I will help you... No, I'll be by your side as we fulfill your dream together.

spans.text: I want to see the Oasis you painted in your dream for myself. I will help you... No, I'll be by your side as we fulfill your dream together.

units.rawText: As I'm about to leave, it hits me that I haven't said the most important part. I turn back and finish my words.
units.displayText: As I'm about to leave, it hits me that I haven't said the most important part. I turn back and finish my words.

spans.text: As I'm about to leave, it hits me that I haven't said the most important part. I turn back and finish my words.

units.rawText: ...One last thing.
units.displayText: ...One last thing.

spans.text: ...One last thing.

units.rawText: Thank you, Persicaria. You brought everyone together, and built an encampment from nothing... You've done more than enough.
units.displayText: Thank you, Persicaria. You brought everyone together, and built an encampment from nothing... You've done more than enough.

spans.text: Thank you, Persicaria. You brought everyone together, and built an encampment from nothing... You've done more than enough.

units.rawText: Leave the rest to me.
units.displayText: Leave the rest to me.

spans.text: Leave the rest to me.

units.rawText: I step out of the tent and close the flap, containing the quiet sobs within.
units.displayText: I step out of the tent and close the flap, containing the quiet sobs within.

spans.text: I step out of the tent and close the flap, containing the quiet sobs within.

units.rawText: Sangoma, I know you're still around.
units.displayText: Sangoma, I know you're still around.

spans.text: Sangoma, I know you're still around.

units.rawText: The purple-haired Doll confirms the absence of other Dolls, appearing from somewhere. She presses her conical hat and comes behind me.
units.displayText: The purple-haired Doll confirms the absence of other Dolls, appearing from somewhere. She presses her conical hat and comes behind me.

spans.text: The purple-haired Doll confirms the absence of other Dolls, appearing from somewhere. She presses her conical hat and comes behind me.

units.rawText: When did you notice me?
units.displayText: When did you notice me?

spans.text: When did you notice me?

units.rawText: At the time Croque mentioned the Sanctifier attack. Judging by the time they fended them off, Persicaria, Sol, and I should have crossed paths with that group of Sanctifiers—but we didn't.
units.displayText: At the time Croque mentioned the Sanctifier attack. Judging by the time they fended them off, Persicaria, Sol, and I should have crossed paths with that group of Sanctifiers—but we didn't.

spans.text: At the time Croque mentioned the Sanctifier attack. Judging by the time they fended them off, Persicaria, Sol, and I should have crossed paths with that group of Sanctifiers—but we didn't.

units.rawText: ...I assume it was you who drove them away, allowing us to arrive at the camp smoothly.
units.displayText: ...I assume it was you who drove them away, allowing us to arrive at the camp smoothly.

spans.text: ...I assume it was you who drove them away, allowing us to arrive at the camp smoothly.

units.rawText: Though that realization came after I found the communicator in the amulet. I assumed you put a tracker in it and you might've been following me all along.
units.displayText: Though that realization came after I found the communicator in the amulet. I assumed you put a tracker in it and you might've been following me all along.

spans.text: Though that realization came after I found the communicator in the amulet. I assumed you put a tracker in it and you might've been following me all along.

units.rawText: She doesn't explain or cover much about her stalking. She laughs it off and changes the subject.
units.displayText: She doesn't explain or cover much about her stalking. She laughs it off and changes the subject.

spans.text: She doesn't explain or cover much about her stalking. She laughs it off and changes the subject.

units.rawText: Haha, so you've figured out my trick. You're more capable than I imagined.
units.displayText: Haha, so you've figured out my trick. You're more capable than I imagined.

spans.text: Haha, so you've figured out my trick. You're more capable than I imagined.

units.rawText: But I assume you aren't just calling me out to make a display of your detective skills.
units.displayText: But I assume you aren't just calling me out to make a display of your detective skills.

spans.text: But I assume you aren't just calling me out to make a display of your detective skills.

units.rawText: ...I just want to confirm your safety. I'm glad to see you doing fine.
units.displayText: ...I just want to confirm your safety. I'm glad to see you doing fine.

spans.text: ...I just want to confirm your safety. I'm glad to see you doing fine.

units.rawText: Hehe, you're so sweet, <cmdr>. I told you not to worry. It's all clear.

spans.text: Hehe, you're so sweet,
. I told you not to worry. It's all clear.

units.rawText: So you dealt with all those Sanctifiers yourself... The same goes for you—you're also way more capable than I imagined.

units.rawText: Hehehe... So what's your request?
units.displayText: Hehehe... So what's your request?

spans.text: Hehehe... So what's your request?

, and I'll need your help on this.

units.rawText: Oh? What do you need me to do?
units.displayText: Oh? What do you need me to do?

spans.text: Oh? What do you need me to do?

units.rawText: We'll have to evade Sanctifiers on our way to Oasis. I've studied their patrol routes and mapped out our path to steer clear of them as much as possible.
units.displayText: We'll have to evade Sanctifiers on our way to Oasis. I've studied their patrol routes and mapped out our path to steer clear of them as much as possible.

spans.text: We'll have to evade Sanctifiers on our way to Oasis. I've studied their patrol routes and mapped out our path to steer clear of them as much as possible.

units.rawText: But in case of inevitable encounters... Sangoma, I'll need you there.
units.displayText: But in case of inevitable encounters... Sangoma, I'll need you there.

spans.text: But in case of inevitable encounters... Sangoma, I'll need you there.

units.rawText: There will be casualties with their current equipment.
units.displayText: There will be casualties with their current equipment.

units.rawText: I can still vividly picture the battlefield Persicaria and Sol stood clearly in my mind.

spans.text: I can still vividly picture the battlefield Persicaria and Sol stood clearly in my mind.

units.rawText: ...They can't afford any more pain.
units.displayText: ...They can't afford any more pain.

spans.text: ...They can't afford any more pain.

units.rawText: You're pushing me real hard, you know. Do you have any idea how challenging it is to lend a hand while keeping out of sight?
units.displayText: You're pushing me real hard, you know. Do you have any idea how challenging it is to lend a hand while keeping out of sight?

spans.text: You're pushing me real hard, you know. Do you have any idea how challenging it is to lend a hand while keeping out of sight?

units.rawText: I've held that question since the beginning. Why do you have to hide yourself?
units.displayText: I've held that question since the beginning. Why do you have to hide yourself?

spans.text: I've held that question since the beginning. Why do you have to hide yourself?

units.rawText: Oh dear, can't an old dame have some secrets?
units.displayText: Oh dear, can't an old dame have some secrets?

spans.text: Oh dear, can't an old dame have some secrets?

units.rawText: Do you know the story of Tsuru no Ongaeshi? The crane will fly away if you force them to reveal themselves, y'know?

units.displayText: She squints her eyes, returning the giant scythe she's holding to her back.

spans.text: She squints her eyes, returning the giant scythe she's holding to her back.

units.rawText: I can help you, but how are you going to repay me after?
units.displayText: I can help you, but how are you going to repay me after?

spans.text: I can help you, but how are you going to repay me after?

units.rawText: What do you want? I'll do my best to meet your demands.
